entries.8927a85734925c2d: As its corporate purpose, the company sets 'simultaneous achievement of happiness for everyone' for its stakeholders, and aims to become a 'research and development-oriented company' that actively contributes to solving social issues. Under its 2026 medium-term plan, the company has four basic policies: expanding development in areas that help solve social issues; innovating agency sales and expanding sales in new areas; pursuing automation and building an optimal production system; and enriching human capital based on a long-term talent development plan. It targets revenue of ¥250 billion or more for fiscal 2026 and ¥300 billion or more for 2030.

entries.e8b7b196c8f61fd0: Building on transformer technology developed since its founding in 1919, the company has expanded into welding machines and industrial robots, and is structured around three technology domains: power equipment, welding and processing, and robots. It has production and sales subsidiaries around the world, including in the United States, Germany, Thailand, China, South Korea and India, and in Material Processing it has transactions with major customers, for example for plasma generation power supplies used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
entries.ed4b3635b9fd687a: It is a reportable segment that manufactures and sells various welding machines, plasma cutting machines, and power supplies for plasma generation. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥76,419 million. Using high-precision control technology for energy sources, it operates in processing areas such as joining, cutting, film formation, surface treatment and shaping of metal, semiconductor and resin materials. Tokyo Electron Miyagi Limited, which has transactions for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, is disclosed as a major customer. In addition to the company, consolidated subsidiaries such as Daihen Sangyo Kiki Co., Ltd. and Daihen Stud Co., Ltd. are responsible for it.
